notes.en: [[character:harumasa]] is a Stun-burst focused Attacker. Keep CRIT Rate around 75% and not more, since he caps early.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,600 to 3,400+, HP 10,000+, DEF 800+, CRIT Rate 75% (not more) and CRIT DMG 150 to 190%.

[[character:dialyn]] is a strong partner because she enables his burst, and she becomes the best when her buffs, Ultimate conversion and Stun extension come together. [[character:qingyi]], [[character:trigger]] and [[character:anby]] are Electric Stunners that provide debuffs or fill in for field time while his damage window is on cooldown. Qingyi is the best of them.

[[character:yuzuha]], [[character:nicole]] and [[character:astra-yao]] are generalist supports. [[character:seed]] buffs Attack agents with Energy, ATK and DMG, and wants to be paired with a main damage dealer.

[[character:rina]] stands out with Electric agents, since she adds PEN Ratio, Shock duration and Electric DMG. [[character:sunna]] is a surprisingly good match because her Stun DMG Multiplier syncs with his in-Stun burst.
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:qingyi]] (Precious Fossilized Core) and [[character:nicole]] (The Vault). Percentages are relative to Zanshin Herb Case.
